test_title: PYST 28: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Evening)
subject: reasoning
question:
The following diagram shows the information collected from a survey in Teachers Colony regarding the social status. The triangle represents families having an AC, the circle represents families having a laptop, the rectangle represents families having a car, and the square represents families having a scooter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8813873a4b207c337314d539911fa76c6900c126169f709a740d0baf788310c.png] 

Find the number of families that have a laptop and scooter both, but neither an AC nor a car.
solution:
The diagram shows intersection of Circle and Square 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5094cf9cfb6e3bfb9dce65976482b0de041ea385956d37f1ded3409ef298bbef.png] 

So '30' represents the families that have a laptop and scooter both, but neither an AC nor a car.

Hence, **"30"** is the correct answer.
